_comment: What an ambiguous English UI string means here. Sent with the key to the model by translate-v07-ui.mjs and retranslate-fields.mjs (file "messages"). Every entry is a key that was mistranslated in two or more locales (audit 2026-10-30: ar, hi, ja read in full; the other ten spot-checked). Add a key when an audit finds a wrong sense; keep the note to what the word means, not how to translate it.
card_cat_constellation: a satellite constellation: a fleet of satellites working together (Starlink, GPS) — not a star constellation
ui_layer_constellations: map layer showing satellite constellations (navigation fleets such as GPS) — not star constellations
lab_f_coverage_title: ground coverage of a satellite constellation (a fleet of satellites) — not star constellations
coast_scrub_aria: drag the timeline slider through the unpowered (engine-off) part of the flight; 'coast' is never a shore, 'scrub' is never cleaning
science_layer_coast_label: preview of the unpowered, engine-off flight path; 'coast' is never a shore
card_stat_transit: flight time from launch to arrival
mp_label_transit: flight time from launch to arrival
plan_label_transit: flight time from launch to arrival
fly_opening_transit: flight time from launch to arrival
launches_status_hold: the launch countdown is on hold (paused)
plan_sandbox_cheaper: this transfer needs less delta-v than the one the user pinned for comparison; 'pinned' is a UI action, never a nail
plan_sandbox_costlier: this transfer needs more delta-v than the one the user pinned for comparison
plan_sandbox_pinned: the cell the user pinned (fixed) for comparison
plan_sandbox_pin_button: button: pin (fix) this cell of the chart for comparison
moon_legend_nation_aria: the map legend (colour key) by country — not a folk tale
moon_panel_capability_title: a new capability this landing achieved for its country (first soft landing, first sample return…) — not accessibility
credits_category_small_body: small bodies of the solar system: asteroids and comets — not a small human body
library_category_small_body: small bodies of the solar system: asteroids and comets — not a small human body
library_kind_vendor_official: the official site of the company that built the hardware (manufacturer) — not a shop seller
library_kind_agency_official: the official site of a space agency — not a sales agency
library_intro_heading: list of external links the site points to — 'inventory' is a list, not stock in a shop
mp_flight_label_tcm_count: how many trajectory correction manoeuvres (TCM) the flight made — 'count' is a number, not an account
ui_view_controls: controls for the 3D view (zoom, rotate, reset)
launches_banner_all: all rocket launches; 'launch' is never a product release
launches_loading: loading the list of rocket launches; 'launch' is never a product release
launches_banner_eyebrow: upcoming rocket launches; 'launch' is never a product release
launches_tier_routine: an ordinary launch, not a featured one
ui_layer_traverses: map layer: the routes rovers drove on the surface
surface_flat_layer_traverse: map layer: the route a rover drove on the surface
iss_blueprint_label_side: side view of a technical drawing
tiangong_blueprint_label_side: side view of a technical drawing
iss_index_close: close the list (index) of station modules
tiangong_index_close: close the list (index) of station modules
why_caveat_title: why this warning about the number's limits? ('caveat' = a limitation, never a cave)
moon_view_libration: lunar libration (the Moon's apparent wobble) — not nutation
layout_footer_readme: link to the project's README file; keep the word README
microgravity_legend_port_starboard: ship directions: left side · right side of the station
station_banner_eyebrow: orbital regime: the altitude band of the orbit (LEO, MEO, GEO)
credits_relationship_quoted: the text is quoted word for word from the source — not a price estimate
credits_used_on: where on the site this source is used
explore_mw_kind_satellite: a satellite galaxy: a small galaxy orbiting the Milky Way
explore_lg_group_andromeda: a satellite galaxy of the Andromeda Galaxy
lab_report_card: an image card summarising the result that the user can share
iss_label_builder: who built the module (agency or company)
science_layer_hover_label: information cards shown when the pointer rests (hovers) on an object
fly_capcom_anomaly_critical: severity level of an anomaly: critical
panel_orbit_shape_highly: the orbit is a very elongated ellipse
mp_flight_label_dla: declination of the launch asymptote (DLA), an orbital-mechanics term
lab_f_guidance_minpitch: the lowest pitch angle reached on a lofted ascent trajectory
fly_hud_velocity: heliocentric delta-v (speed relative to the Sun)
lab_f_corridor_glimit: the highest deceleration (in g) a crew can survive
colophon_lab_illustrations: illustrations used in the site's Physics Lab section (translate 'Physics Lab')
science_tab_watch_list: tab: films and videos to watch
station_banner_long_duration_link: link: how long humans can stay in space (endurance on long missions)
sourcing_status_partial: only some of the sources for this item were found
